placements.why: The document records a spectrograph calibration session and its settled outcomes, establishing calibration as an organizational category nothing existing covers.
placements.title: Calibration as organizational practice
placements.frame: What calibration activities does this organization treat as load-bearing?

placements.title: Principal authority as verification warrant
placements.frame: How does naming a principal lend epistemic weight to instrument verification claims?
placements.why: src-1 names Quill as principal and src-2 reports the calibration verification under that footing — the theme is how authority invocation functions as a warrant for calibration claims.

placements.title: Verified calibration recorded as decision
placements.frame: What transforms a calibration result into a ratified organizational decision?
placements.why: src-3 frames the outcomes as 'Key decisions' and src-4/src-5 record the instrument and calibration value as settled determinations with a verification basis.
